How to use

  • Diffuse 5 drops through a morning work session.
  • Blend 3 drops into an unscented body lotion.
  • Combine with cinnamon and clove for a warming winter diffusion.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Scent profile

  • Candied peel
  • Bright juice
  • Clean sweetness

What's in it

  • 100% cold-pressed Citrus sinensis peel oil

Who it's for

Households with children or guests

The least divisive scent we sell. Almost nobody actively dislikes sweet orange, which is not true of most oils.

First-time diffuser owners

Inexpensive enough to use generously while you work out how many drops your room actually needs.

Blending beginners

Forgiving. It sits comfortably under almost anything else, so a blend involving orange is hard to get badly wrong.

What people get wrong

Storing it for years. Cold-pressed citrus oils oxidise far faster than distilled oils — expect about a year from opening, not three. An orange oil that has turned smells sharp and faintly of cardboard.

Over-diffusing it. Because it is cheap and pleasant, people pour it in. Five drops scents a room; fifteen makes it cloying and wastes the bottle.

What it won't do

It is a short-lived top note. In a blend it is the first thing you smell and the first thing to disappear, usually within the hour, which is why it is normally paired with something slower underneath.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Sweet Orange Sunrise

How long does it keep?

About a year from opening, which is shorter than most of our range. Cold-pressed citrus oils oxidise quickly. Keep the cap tight, store it somewhere cool and dark, and buy the smaller bottle if you diffuse occasionally.

Is sweet orange phototoxic like bergamot?

No. Sweet orange is one of the few cold-pressed citrus oils that is not meaningfully phototoxic, so it is safe to use in a diluted skin blend during the day. Bitter orange, bergamot, lemon and grapefruit are different.

What does it blend well with?

Nearly everything. Cinnamon and clove for winter, cedarwood or frankincense for something warmer and longer-lasting, peppermint for a sharper morning blend.

How long does it keep once opened?

About a year. Cold-pressed citrus oils oxidise faster than distilled ones, and an oxidised citrus oil is both flatter to smell and more likely to irritate skin.

What dilution should I use on skin?

Around 2% for the body — roughly 12 drops per 30 ml of carrier oil — and 1% for the face. Always patch-test before wider use, and never apply neat.

Can I take it internally?

No. None of our oils are food grade and none are sold for internal use. Essential oils are extremely concentrated, and advice to add them to water or food is not advice we endorse.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
